searchText: MSRP $252,796. The All-New 2026 Entegra Coach Vision XL 31UL Class A Luxury RV Features Full Body Paint Customer Value Package Power Theater Seating Front Overhead Loft More About This RV The Entegra Coach Vision XL is built for your next adventure and includes all new features such as new exterior graphics package, all new full body paint exteriors, infotainment center changed to Sony w/apple car play and android auto, solid surface counters upgraded to match in bathroom and bedroom. This beautiful RV features automatic hydraulic leveling jacks, Ford chassis. This amazing RV boasts Customer Value Package which features 5.5 KW generator, 50 amp electrical service, 1,200 watt inverter, Automatic hydraulic leveling jacks, Backup and sideview camera, Driver/passenger cockpit table, Electric awning with LED lights, Exterior entertainment center with LED TV and single disc DVD/FM radio, Frameless windows, Infotainment system, E-Z Drive Elite package, LED TV in living room, Roller shades, Slideout cover awnings and Solid-surface kitchen countertops. The Vision XL's impressive list of standard features that truly set it apart from the competition include Entegra's unparalleled 2 year warranty, one-piece fiberglass front cap, panoramic windshield with power shade, seamless crowned fiberglass roof, ball-bearing drawer guides, large shower and much more.
